lines.en: You look tired, Mia. When we spoke last night, you said your relatives had been arguing for hours.
lines.pt: Você parece cansada, Mia. Quando falamos ontem à noite, você disse que seus parentes estavam discutindo havia horas.

lines.en: They had! By the time dinner was served, they had been arguing about the wedding for almost three hours.
lines.pt: Estavam mesmo! Quando o jantar foi servido, eles já discutiam sobre o casamento havia quase três horas.

lines.en: Over what, exactly? I thought they had been planning it together since January.
lines.pt: Por quê, exatamente? Achei que eles estavam planejando tudo juntos desde janeiro.

lines.en: They had, but my aunt had been saving money for the venue, and my uncle had been hoping for a smaller party.
lines.pt: Estavam, mas minha tia vinha economizando para o local, e meu tio vinha torcendo por uma festa menor.

lines.en: So nobody had been listening. You sounded stressed on the phone. Had you been shouting before you called me?
lines.pt: Então ninguém estava ouvindo. Você parecia estressada ao telefone. Estava gritando antes de me ligar?

lines.en: Yes, I had. I had been trying to calm everyone down, and my voice was almost gone by midnight.
lines.pt: Estava, sim. Eu estava tentando acalmar todo mundo, e minha voz quase tinha sumido à meia-noite.

lines.en: Poor you. How long had they been shouting before someone finally stopped the fight?
lines.pt: Coitada. Há quanto tempo eles estavam gritando até que alguém finalmente parou a briga?

lines.en: Nearly two hours. My cousin had been sitting quietly in the corner, then she suddenly stood up and told them to stop.
lines.pt: Quase duas horas. Minha prima estava sentada quieta no canto, e então se levantou de repente e mandou que parassem.

lines.en: Good for her. If they had been listening to each other from the start, they would not have wasted the whole night.
lines.pt: Muito bem para ela. Se eles tivessem ouvido uns aos outros desde o início, não teriam desperdiçado a noite toda.

lines.en: Exactly. The strange thing is that they had been getting along perfectly until the moment the budget came up.
lines.pt: Exato. O estranho é que eles estavam se dando perfeitamente bem até o momento em que o orçamento surgiu.

lines.en: Money does that. Let’s have breakfast, and you can tell me whether they have made any decision this morning.
lines.pt: Dinheiro faz isso. Vamos tomar café, e você me conta se eles tomaram alguma decisão esta manhã.

facts.label: Past perfect contínuo
facts.sub: Ação em andamento até um momento do passado: They’d been arguing for hours. Pergunta: How long had they been shouting? Com for e since.

facts.label: Há quanto tempo
facts.sub: For mostra o período (for three hours); since mostra o ponto de início (since January). Ambos funcionam com had been + -ing: She had been waiting since noon.

facts.label: How long had…?

pages.title: A very long family dinner · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Sunday morning in Austin. Dirk meets his friend Sara outside a taco place. Sara has not slept much. The tension had been growing for weeks. Her family had a difficult dinner yesterday. Now she wants to tell the whole story.

“You look tired, Sara. When we spoke last night, you said your relatives had been arguing for hours.” says Dirk. “They had! By the time dinner was served, they had been arguing about the wedding for almost three hours.” says Sara. “Over what, exactly? I thought they had been planning it together since January.” says Dirk.
